1.def: Present Perfect — o'tgan ishni HOZIR bilan bog'laydi: natijasi hozir muhim yoki davr hali tugamagan. Past Simple — o'tmishda qolgan ishni aytadi: qachon bo'lgani aniq va u davr tugagan.
uses: I've lost my keys, so I can't get in.
Perfect: o'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etyapti
We have known each other since school.
Past Simple: tugagan va vaqti aniq ish
I lost my keys on Monday.
Past Simple: hayoti yoki davri tugagan narsa haqida
1.tip: O'zingizdan so'rang: «Qachon?» degan savolga javob gapda bormi? Bor bo'lsa — Past Simple. Yo'q bo'lsa va hozirga ta'siri bo'lsa — Present Perfect.
rules: Aniq o'tgan vaqt so'zi bilan Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI.
today / this week: davr hali tugamagan bo'lsa Perfect, tugagan bo'lsa Past Simple (I've had two coffees this morning — hozir ham ertalab).
Yangilik Perfect bilan boshlanadi, tafsilot Past Simple bilan: I've had an accident. A car hit me.
gone — ketdi va qaytmadi; been — borib qaytdi.
It's the first / second time + Present Perfect.
ex: She has worked here for ten years.
U o'n yildan beri shu yerda ishlaydi (hozir ham).
She worked there for ten years.
U u yerda o'n yil ishlagan (endi ishlamaydi).
Have you finished? Yes, I finished an hour ago.
Tugatdingmi? Ha, bir soat oldin tugatdim.
He has gone to Tashkent.
U Toshkentga ketgan (hali qaytmagan).

2.def: Ikkalasi ham o'tmishni hozirga bog'laydi. Simple NATIJAGA qaraydi: nima tayyor bo'ldi, nechta, necha marta. Continuous JARAYONGA qaraydi: qancha vaqtdan beri, nima bilan band edingiz.
uses: She has called him three times.
I've been waiting for an hour.
Continuous: izi hozir ko'rinib turgan faoliyat
You're out of breath. Have you been running?
forms: I haven't written a single email.
How many + ot + have + S + V3?
How many emails have you written?
I've been writing emails all morning.
How long + have + S + been + V-ing?
How long have you been waiting?
rules: Holat fe'llari (know, like, love, own, belong, understand) Continuous bo'lmaydi.
Son yoki miqdor aytilsa — Simple: I've read 50 pages.
live, work, teach bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin, farqi deyarli yo'q.
Continuous ko'pincha ish tugamaganini bildiradi: I've been reading your book (hali tugatmadim).
ex: I've read that book. It's brilliant.
U kitobni o'qiganman (tugatganman).
I've been reading that book all week.
Butun hafta o'sha kitobni o'qiyapman.
She's been crying; her eyes are red.
U yig'lagan, ko'zlari qizarib turibdi.
How long have you known Anvar?
Anvarni qachondan beri taniysiz?
err: I've been knowing him for years.
I've been reading three books this month.
I've read three books this month.
How long have you been waiting?

3.def: Uch zamon hikoyada vaqt tartibini ko'rsatadi: Past Simple — asosiy voqealar zanjiri; Past Continuous — o'sha paytda davom etayotgan fon; Past Perfect — o'sha voqealardan HAM OLDIN bo'lgan ish.
uses: He opened the door, went in and sat down.
Past Continuous: fon yoki bo'linib qolgan jarayon
I was cooking when the phone rang.
Past Perfect: o'tmishdagi voqeadan oldingi ish
The film had started before we arrived.
forms: Did the train leave at six?
Was it raining when you left?
Had the train left by then?
3.tip: Vaqt chizig'ini tasavvur qiling: eng oldingisi — had + V3, cho'zilgani — was + V-ing, qisqa voqea — V2.
rules: when + qisqa voqea, while + davomli jarayon.
by the time … bilan oldingi ish Past Perfect bo'ladi.
before / after tartibni o'zi ko'rsatsa, Past Simple ham yetarli: After he left, I called her.
When I arrived, he left (kelgach ketdi) ≠ When I arrived, he had left (men kelmasdan ketgan).
ex: I was walking home when I realised I had left my phone at work.
Uyga ketayotib telefonimni ishxonada qoldirganimni tushundim.
She had already eaten when we came.
Biz kelganimizda u ovqatlanib bo'lgan edi.
While we were talking, the lights went out.
Gaplashib turganimizda chiroq o'chdi.
err: When I got there, the film already started.
When I got there, the film had already started.
While I cooked, the phone was ringing once.
While I was cooking, the phone rang.

4.def: Narrative tenses — hikoya aytishda ishlatiladigan 4 zamon. Past Perfect Continuous o'tmishdagi biror paytgacha DAVOM ETGAN jarayonni bildiradi va ko'pincha o'sha paytdagi holatning sababini tushuntiradi.
uses: Davomiylik: o'tmishdagi voqeagacha qancha davom etgani
We had been walking for hours when we saw a light.
Sabab: o'tmishdagi holat nimadan kelib chiqqani
Her eyes hurt because she had been reading all night.
Natija yoki son kerak bo'lsa — Past Perfect Simple
By noon he had written three reports.
forms: She had been waiting for two hours.
4.tip: had been + -ing = «ancha vaqtdan beri qilayotgan edi».
rules: Holat fe'llari (know, be, have = ega bo'lmoq) Continuous olmaydi: I had known her for years.
Davomiylik / sabab — Continuous; natija / son — Simple.
Hamma gapni had bilan to'ldirmang: tartib aniq bo'lgach, Past Simple'ga qayting.
ex: The ground was wet. It had been raining all night.
Yer ho'l edi. Tuni bilan yomg'ir yoqqan edi.
I had been studying for hours, so I was exhausted.
Soatlab o'qiganim uchun holdan toygan edim.
They had been living there for years before they moved.
Ko'chishdan oldin ular u yerda yillab yashashgan edi.
err: She was tired because she worked all night.
She was tired because she had been working all night.
He had been knowing her since 2010.

5.def: used to va would — o'tmishda bo'lgan, hozir esa yo'q odat. be used to — biror narsaga ko'nikkanman. get used to — ko'nikib boryapman. Tashqi ko'rinishi o'xshash, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.
uses: used to: o'tmishdagi odat yoki holat
I used to live in Bukhara.
Every summer we would visit my grandparents.
be used to: ko'nikkanman, g'alati emas
I'm used to getting up early.
You'll soon get used to the noise.
forms: My father would read to us at night.
S + be + used to + V-ing / ot
She is used to working at night.
S + get + used to + V-ing / ot
I'm getting used to the cold.
5.tip: Oldida am / is / are / get bormi? Bor bo'lsa, keyin -ing (yoki ot). Yo'q bo'lsa (used to), keyin oddiy fe'l.
rules: would holat fe'llari bilan ishlatilmaydi: I used to have a dog (would have emas).
used to faqat o'tmishda; hozirgi odat uchun usually ishlating.
be / get used to ichidagi to — predlog, shuning uchun keyin -ing.
be used to istalgan zamonda keladi: was used to, will get used to.
ex: When I was a child, I would play outside for hours.
Bolaligimda soatlab ko'chada o'ynardim.
She used to be shy, but now she isn't.
U ilgari uyatchan edi, hozir unday emas.
After a month I got used to the noise.
Bir oydan keyin shovqinga ko'nikdim.
err: I would live in Samarkand when I was a child.
I used to live in Samarkand when I was a child.
I'm used to get up early.
I'm used to getting up early.

6.def: Ingliz tilida bitta kelasi zamon yo'q: shakl gapiruvchining NUQTAI NAZARIGA qarab tanlanadi — hozirgina qaror qildimi, oldindan rejalaganmi, jadvalmi yoki ma'lum paytda jarayonda / tugagan bo'ladimi.
uses: will: shu zahotiy qaror, va'da, taxmin
going to: niyat yoki ko'rinib turgan belgi
Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
The train leaves at seven tomorrow.
This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Dubai.
forms: S + am / is / are + going to + V1
I will be working at nine.
They will have finished by Friday.
Will they have finished by Friday?
6.tip: at (shu paytda) — will be + -ing. by (shu paytgacha) — will have + V3.
rules: when, if, as soon as, before, until dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi: I'll call when I arrive.
Bashorat: fikrga asoslansa will, hozirgi dalilga asoslansa going to.
Odob bilan reja so'rash: Will you be using the car tonight?
ex: By next June I will have finished my degree.
Kelasi iyungacha o'qishni tugatgan bo'laman.
At 8 pm tomorrow I will be watching the match.
Ertaga soat 20 da o'yin ko'rayotgan bo'laman.
The conference starts at nine on Monday.
Konferensiya dushanba kuni to'qqizda boshlanadi.
err: By 5 pm I will finish the report.
By 5 pm I will have finished the report.
I'll call you when I will arrive.
I'll call you when I arrive.
Tomorrow I will be meeting him.

7.def: Shart gap ikki qismdan iborat: shart (if …) va natija. Zero — doim to'g'ri qonuniyat; First — kelajakda real bo'lishi mumkin; Second — xayoliy yoki ehtimoli juft past vaziyat (hozir / kelajak).
uses: If you heat ice, it melts.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
If I were you, I would apologise.
You'll be late unless you hurry.
as long as / provided — faqat shu shart bilan
You can borrow it as long as you return it.
Take a coat in case it gets cold.
forms: If I drink coffee late, I don't sleep.
If she studies, she will pass.
If + S + don't / doesn't + V1, S + won't + V1
If you don't call, I won't wait.
If + Past Simple, S + would + V1
If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.
What would + S + V1 + if + Past Simple?
What would you do if you won a million?
7.tip: Zamon bir qadam «orqaga» ketsa, haqiqatdan ham bir qadam uzoqlashadi: Present — real, Past — xayoliy.
rules: if qismida will / would ishlatilmaydi.
unless = if … not, shuning uchun undan keyin darak gap keladi.
Second'da barcha shaxslar uchun were ishlatish mumkin: If I were rich…
in case — natijani emas, oldindan ko'rilgan chorani bildiradi.
if gap boshida bo'lsa vergul qo'yiladi.
ex: I'll go as long as you come with me.
Sen birga borsang, boraman.
Unless you leave now, you'll miss the bus.
Hozir chiqmasangiz, avtobusdan qolasiz.
If I lived closer, I would walk to work.
Yaqinroq yashaganimda ishga piyoda borardim.
err: If it will rain, we'll stay.
Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
In case it will rain, take an umbrella.
In case it rains, take an umbrella.

8.def: Third conditional — O'TMISHNI xayolan o'zgartirish (aslida bunday bo'lmagan). Mixed conditional — shart bir vaqtda, natija boshqa vaqtda: o'tmishdagi ish hozirga ta'sir qiladi yoki doimiy xususiyat o'tmishga ta'sir qilgan.
uses: If you had told me, I would have helped.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If she were more careful, she wouldn't have broken it.
forms: If + had + V3, S + would have + V3
If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
If + hadn't + V3, S + wouldn't have + V3
If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't have stayed.
What would + S + have + V3 + if + had + V3?
What would you have done if you had seen it?
If + had + V3, S + would + V1
If I had slept well, I wouldn't be tired.
If + Past Simple, S + would have + V3
If I spoke French, I would have understood him.
signals: yesterday / last year — would have + V3
8.tip: Har bir qismni alohida tekshiring: bu qism qaysi vaqt haqida? Shakl shunga qarab tanlanadi.
rules: if qismida would have ishlatilmaydi.
would o'rniga could have (qila olardim) yoki might have (balki) mumkin.
Rasmiy uslubda if tushib qoladi: Had I known, I would have come.
'd ikki xil: I'd known = had; I'd go = would.
ex: If I had taken the job, I would be living in London now.
O'sha ishni olganimda hozir Londonda yashagan bo'lardim.
Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
Tirbandlikni bilganimda ertaroq chiqardim.
If he weren't so lazy, he would have passed.
U bunchalik dangasa bo'lmaganida imtihondan o'tardi.
err: If I would have known, I would have gone.
If I had known, I would have gone.
If I had won, I would have been rich now.
If I had won, I would be rich now.

9.def: Bu konstruksiyalar haqiqatda YO'Q narsani istash, afsuslanish yoki maslahat berishni bildiradi. Muhim qoida: ma'no hozirga tegishli bo'lsa ham fe'l bir pog'ona orqaga (Past) suriladi.
uses: wish / if only + Past: hozirgi holatdan afsus
I wish I had a bigger flat.
wish / if only + had V3: o'tmishdan afsus
If only I had listened to you.
I wish you would stop shouting.
had better: hozir shunday qilgan ma'qul
forms: She wishes she knew the answer.
He wishes he hadn't sold the car.
S + wish + boshqa S + would + V1
I wish it would stop raining.
I'd rather not talk about it.
S + would rather + boshqa S + Past Simple
I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
We had better not be late.
It's time you went to bed.
9.tip: if only = wish, faqat hissiyoti kuchliroq: «Qaniydi!»
rules: wish + would o'zingiz haqingizda ishlatilmaydi (I wish I would emas, I wish I could).
be fe'li bilan were ham to'g'ri: I wish I were taller.
had better dan keyin to qo'yilmaydi.
it's time + to + V1 ham mumkin: It's time to go.
Umid uchun wish emas, hope: I hope you pass.
ex: I wish I could speak French.
Koshki fransuzcha gapira olsam.
If only I had saved some money!
Qaniydi, oz bo'lsa ham pul yig'ganimda!
You had better take an umbrella.
Soyabon olganingiz ma'qul.
err: I wish I have more time.
I wish I had more time.

10.def: Majhul nisbatda diqqat ishni KIM qilganiga emas, NIMA qilinganiga qaratiladi. have / get something done esa ishni o'zingiz emas, boshqa odam (usta, xizmatchi) siz uchun bajarganini bildiradi.
uses: My bike was stolen last night.
I had my hair cut yesterday.
forms: We are having the house painted.
Do / Did + S + have + ot + V3?
Did you have your car serviced?
10.tip: Zamonni be ko'rsatadi, ma'noni V3 beradi. Zamonni almashtirish uchun faqat be ni o'zgartiring.
rules: Zamonlar: is done · is being done · was done · was being done · has been done · had been done · will be done.
Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'lda ko'proq shaxs ega bo'ladi: He was offered a job.
die, happen, arrive kabi o'timsiz fe'llar passiv bo'lmaydi.
I cut my hair — o'zim; I had my hair cut — sartarosh.
ex: The report is being written now.
Hisobot hozir yozilyapti.
He is said to be very rich.
Aytishlaricha, u juda boy.
I'm having my flat painted next week.
Kelasi hafta uyimni bo'yattiraman.
err: The accident was happened at night.
I had cut my hair at the barber's.
I had my hair cut at the barber's.
The room is cleaned every day.

11.def: Reported speech — birovning gapini o'z so'zingiz bilan yetkazish. Kiritish fe'li o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa (said, asked), ichki gapning zamoni odatda bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi, olmosh va vaqt so'zlari ham moslashadi.
uses: She asked if I was ready.
The teacher told us to sit down.
forms: am / is → was ; do → did ; did / have done → had done
will → would ; can → could ; may → might ; must → had to
He asked what time the film started.
She asked if I had a car.
He told me not to wait.
11.tip: Ko'chirma savol endi savol emas: do / does / did yo'qoladi, so'z tartibi darak gapnikiday bo'ladi.
rules: say + (to kim); tell + kim: He said to me / He told me.
Hali ham to'g'ri bo'lgan faktda zamon surilmasligi mumkin: She said water boils at 100 degrees.
would, could, might, should o'zgarmaydi.
Ko'chirma savol oxirida so'roq belgisi qo'yilmaydi.
ex: She said she had never been abroad.
U hech qachon chet elda bo'lmaganini aytdi.
He asked me where I was going.
U qayerga ketayotganimni so'radi.
They said they would be late.
Ular kechikishlarini aytishdi.
err: She asked me where did I work.
She asked me where I worked.
He said me he was tired.
He told me he was tired.
He told me to not wait.
He told me not to wait.

12.def: Reporting verbs gapni so'zma-so'z emas, MAQSADI bilan yetkazadi: va'da berdi, ogohlantirdi, tan oldi. Har bir fe'lning o'z «qolipi» bor — uni fe'l bilan birga yodlash kerak.
forms: verb + to + V1  (promise, offer, refuse, agree, threaten)
verb + kim + (not) to + V1  (advise, warn, invite, remind, encourage)
He warned us not to swim there.
verb + predlog + V-ing  (apologise for, insist on)
verb + kim + predlog + V-ing  (accuse of, thank for, blame for)
verb + that + S + V  (explain, claim, admit)
He claimed that he was innocent.
12.tip: Avval gapning vazifasini toping (va'da? maslahat? ayblov?), keyin mos fe'l va uning qolipini tanlang.
rules: suggest + to ishlatilmaydi: suggested going yoki suggested that we go.
explain dan keyin kishi to'g'ridan kelmaydi: explained to me.
inkor shakli: not to + V1 yoki not + V-ing.
remind + kim + to + V1 — eslatmoq.
ex: She suggested taking a taxi.
U taksida borishni taklif qildi.
He denied breaking the window.
U derazani sindirganini rad etdi.
The doctor warned me not to eat late.
Shifokor kech ovqatlanmaslik haqida ogohlantirdi.
err: He explained the rule to me.

13.def: Deduction — dalillarga qarab xulosa chiqarish. must — deyarli aminman, shunday; may / might / could — ehtimol; can't — mumkin emas. O'tmish haqida taxmin qilsak modaldan keyin have + V3 keladi.
uses: You've been working all day. You must be tired.
She isn't answering. She might be asleep.
That can't be Tom. He's abroad.
The streets are wet. It must have rained.
forms: S + must / might / can't + be + V-ing
They might be waiting for us.
S + must / might / could + have + V3
She must have missed the bus.
S + must / might + have been + V-ing
13.tip: Shkala: must (aniq ha) → might (balki) → can't (aniq yo'q).
rules: Xulosada must ning inkori — can't (mustn't emas).
could = balki, lekin couldn't = mumkin emas.
may not / might not — «balki yo'q», can't — «bo'lishi mumkin emas».
Kontekstga qarang: must majburiyatni ham bildiradi.
ex: She can't have forgotten; she wrote it down.
U unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas, yozib qo'ygandi.
They might have got lost.
Ular adashib qolgan bo'lishi mumkin.
You must be joking!
Hazillashayotgan bo'lsang kerak!

14.def: Modal + have + V3 o'tmishga bugungi baho beradi: nima qilish kerak edi, nima qila olardik, nima ortiqcha bo'ldi. Majburiyatning o'zi (shunday qilishga to'g'ri kelgani) esa had to bilan aytiladi.
uses: Afsus yoki tanqid: kerak edi, qilinmadi
You needn't have bought bread. We had some.
I could have won the race.
forms: S + should / ought to + have + V3
14.tip: should have = aslida bo'lmagan. shouldn't have = aslida bo'lgan. Har doim «teskarisi sodir bo'lgan».
rules: must o'tgan zamonga ega emas — had to ishlatiladi.
needn't have done: ish QILINDI; didn't need to do: kerak emas edi (odatda qilinmagan).
should of — xato yozuv; to'g'risi should have.
must have + V3 majburiyat emas, balki xulosa.
ex: I should have saved the file.
Faylni saqlashim kerak edi.
You shouldn't have spent so much.
Buncha ko'p pul sarflamasliging kerak edi.
We had to cancel the trip.
Sayohatni bekor qilishga majbur bo'ldik.
err: I must go to the bank yesterday.
I had to go to the bank yesterday.

15.def: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing ham, to + V1 ham kela oladi, lekin MA'NO o'zgaradi. Odatda to + V1 oldinga qaraydi (qilish kerak bo'lgan ish), -ing esa allaqachon bo'lgan yoki sinab ko'rilgan ishni bildiradi.
uses: Remember to lock the door. I remember locking it.
stop: to'xtatmoq / boshqa ish uchun to'xtamoq
He stopped smoking. He stopped to smoke.
I tried to open it. Try restarting the phone.
regret: afsus bilan aytaman / qilganimdan afsus
I regret to say no. I regret saying that.
go on: keyingi bosqich / davom etish
He went on to become a minister. He went on talking.
I meant to call. The job means moving abroad.
forms: Don't forget to pay the bill.
need + to + V1 ≠ need + V-ing (passiv ma'no)
15.tip: to — o'q kabi oldinga ko'rsatadi; -ing — davom etayotgan yoki xotirada turgan ish.
rules: forget + -ing ko'pincha will never forget bilan keladi.
try + to — qiyin ishni uddalashga urinish; try + -ing — yechim sifatida sinash.
need + -ing = need to be + V3.
like, love, start, begin bilan ma'no deyarli o'zgarmaydi.
ex: I forgot to buy milk, so we have none.
Sut olish esimdan chiqdi, shuning uchun yo'q.
She stopped to answer her phone.
U telefonga javob berish uchun to'xtadi.
If you have a headache, try drinking water.
Boshing og'risa, suv ichib ko'r.
err: I've stopped to smoke. I'm healthier now.
I've stopped smoking. I'm healthier now.
I remember to meet her in 2010.

16.def: Verb pattern — fe'ldan keyin ikkinchi fe'l qanday shaklda kelishi. Uni mantiq bilan topib bo'lmaydi: shaklni asosiy fe'l belgilaydi, shuning uchun fe'llar guruh bo'lib yodlanadi.
uses: Birovdan biror ish kutish: kim + to
My parents let me stay up late.
I saw him crossing the road.
forms: verb + to + V1  (decide, hope, plan, agree, manage, afford)
verb + V-ing  (enjoy, avoid, consider, risk, mind, finish)
verb + kim + to + V1  (want, ask, tell, allow, expect, teach)
see / hear + kim + V1 yoki V-ing
16.tip: Kelajakka intilish bildiruvchi fe'llar (hope, plan, decide) — to; tajriba va his (enjoy, miss, avoid) — -ing.
rules: make va let dan keyin to yo'q.
see + V1 — ishni to'liq ko'rdim; see + V-ing — jarayonining bir qismini.
inkor: decide not to go; avoid not sleeping.
want, would like dan keyin that-gap ishlatilmaydi: I want you to know.
ex: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
O'qituvchi inshoni qayta yozdirdi.
I'd like you to meet my friend.
Do'stim bilan tanishishingizni xohlardim.
It's not worth worrying about.
Bunga qayg'urishga arzimaydi.

17.def: Relative clause otning orqasidan kelib uni tushuntiradi. Defining — QAYSI biri ekanini aniqlaydi (vergulsiz, olib tashlab bo'lmaydi). Non-defining — qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi (vergul bilan, olib tashlansa ham gap tushunarli).
uses: Qaysi odam yoki narsa ekanini aniqlash
The woman who lives upstairs is a nurse.
My sister, who lives in Dubai, is a nurse.
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
I don't know what he wants.
forms: The man who called was polite.
The phone that I bought is broken.
The boy whose bike was stolen is here.
This is the house where I grew up.
ot, + who / which + gap, + gap davomi
Tashkent, which is very green, is my home.
The man to whom I spoke was helpful.
17.tip: Vergul bormi? Unda that taqiqlanadi va olmoshni tushirib bo'lmaydi.
rules: Olmosh to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa (keyin yana ega kelsa), defining'da tushib qolishi mumkin: the film (that) I saw.
Olmoshdan keyin ega takrorlanmaydi.
what oldida ot kelmaydi.
Og'zaki nutqda predlog oxiriga o'tadi: the man I spoke to.
ex: The film, which lasted three hours, won an award.
Uch soat davom etgan film mukofot oldi.
Is there anything I can do?
Qila oladigan biror ishim bormi?
She's the colleague whose advice I trust.
U maslahatiga ishonadigan hamkasbim.
err: My father, that is a doctor, is retired.
My father, who is a doctor, is retired.
The woman who her son is a pilot lives here.
The woman whose son is a pilot lives here.
The book which I bought it is good.
The book which I bought is good.

18.def: Artikl tinglovchiga signal beradi: a / an — «biror bir, hali sizga noma'lum»; the — «o'sha, qaysiligini ikkalamiz bilamiz»; artiklsiz — «umuman shu narsa» (ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar).
uses: a / an: birinchi marta tilga olish, kasb
The sun is very hot today.
the: orttirma daraja va tartib son
It was the best day of my life.
Dogs are loyal. I love music.
forms: I saw a fox in a field.
The fox ran into the trees.
The rich should help the poor.
signals: the Nile, the Alps, the USA, the UK
18.tip: Savol bering: «Qaysi biri?» Javob aniq bo'lsa — the. «Ixtiyoriy bittasi» — a. «Hammasi, umuman» — artiklsiz.
rules: a / an tanlovi tovushga qarab: an hour, a university.
Sanalmaydigan ot a / an olmaydi.
Daryo, dengiz, okean, tog' tizmasi va Republic / Kingdom / States bilan the.
Shahar, ko'pchilik mamlakat, til, fan oldida artikl yo'q.
go to school (o'qishga) ≠ go to the school (binoga).
ex: He is at university; his mother works at the university.
U universitetda o'qiydi; onasi o'sha universitetda ishlaydi.
Life is short.
Hayot qisqa.
The Nile is the longest river in Africa.
Nil — Afrikadagi eng uzun daryo.

19.def: Quantifier — miqdorni bildiruvchi so'z. Tanlov otning turiga bog'liq: sanaladigan (books, cars) yoki sanalmaydigan (money, advice, information). Ba'zi so'zlar esa ikkalasi bilan ham ishlaydi.
uses: a few / a little: oz, lekin yetarli (ijobiy)
I have a few friends here.
a lot of / plenty of: ko'p
forms: many / (a) few / fewer / several + ko'plik ot
a lot of / plenty of / some / any / enough + ot
each / every / either / neither + birlik ot
most / some / none + of the + ot
Most of the guests left early.
a piece of / an item of + sanalmaydigan ot
Let me give you a piece of advice.
19.tip: a borligi kayfiyatni o'zgartiradi: a little water — ozgina bor; little water — deyarli yo'q.
rules: Sanalmaydigan ot -s olmaydi, fe'li birlikda: The news is good.
some — darak va taklifda; any — inkor va savolda.
most people, lekin most of the people.
neither + birlik fe'l; both + ko'plik fe'l.
ex: I need some advice about my studies.
O'qishim bo'yicha maslahat kerak.
There is hardly any furniture in the room.
Xonada mebel deyarli yo'q.
Both films were good, but neither was great.
Ikkala film ham yaxshi, lekin hech biri zo'r emas edi.
err: He gave me a lot of information.
She gave me a good advice.
She gave me some good advice.

20.def: Qiyoslash faqat «kattaroq / eng katta» emas: farq QANCHA ekanini (much, slightly), tenglikni (as … as), o'zaro bog'liqlikni (the more …, the more …) va sifat darajasini (very, absolutely) aniq ifodalash mumkin.
uses: This phone is far cheaper than that one.
He isn't as tall as his father.
The sooner we start, the better.
It's getting more and more difficult.
forms: Trains are more comfortable than buses.
The sequel is not as good as the film.
much / far / a bit / slightly + qiyosiy
the + qiyosiy + S + V, the + qiyosiy + S + V
The more you practise, the faster you improve.
twice / three times + as + adj + as
This bag is twice as heavy as mine.
20.tip: very oddiy sifatga (cold), absolutely esa «chegara» sifatga (freezing) qo'yiladi.
rules: Qo'sh qiyos bo'lmaydi (more cheaper emas).
very qiyosiy daraja oldidan kelmaydi — much ishlating.
Gradable: very tired, quite cold; non-gradable: absolutely exhausted, completely impossible.
good → better → best; bad → worse → worst; far → further → furthest.
ex: The new office is nowhere near as big as the old one.
Yangi ofis eskisiday kattalikka yaqin ham emas.
It's by far the best film this year.
Bu — yilning shubhasiz eng yaxshi filmi.
She was absolutely delighted.
U nihoyatda xursand edi.
err: He is very taller than me.
He is much taller than me.

21.def: Bu so'z juftlari o'zbekchada bitta so'zga tarjima bo'lishi mumkin, lekin inglizchada yo'nalishi, turkumi yoki qolipi boshqa. Har birini alohida emas, BIRIKMA holida yodlang.
uses: Can I borrow your pen? I can lend you mine.
Bring it here and take that away.
I made a cake while he did the dishes.
She said sorry and told me the truth.
Prices rise when firms raise them.
forms: say (to kim) + gap ; tell + kim + gap
He told me that he was busy.
borrow X from kim ; lend kim X
I borrowed money from my uncle.
make + a mistake / a decision / money / an effort
do + homework / business / your best / a favour
Could you do me a favour?
affect (fe'l) + ot ; have an effect on + ot
Lay the baby down and lie next to her.
21.tip: Ikki so'z aralashsa, bitta mustahkam birikmani yodlang va shunga tayanib tekshiring: tell me, lend me, make a mistake.
rules: affect — odatda fe'l, effect — odatda ot.
economic — iqtisodga oid; economical — tejamkor.
historic — tarixiy ahamiyatli; historical — tarixga oid.
remember — o'zim eslayman; remind — boshqaga eslataman.
ex: She lent me her book, so I borrowed it for a week.
U kitobini berib turdi, bir haftaga oldim.
Remind me to call the bank.
Bankka qo'ng'iroq qilishni eslatib qo'y.
The weather had a serious effect on the harvest.
Ob-havo hosilga jiddiy ta'sir qildi.
err: Can you borrow me your pen?
Can you lend me your pen?

22.def: Dependent preposition — fe'l, sifat yoki otga «yopishib» keladigan predlog: uni ma'nodan keltirib chiqarib bo'lmaydi. Vaqt va joy predloglarida esa aniq mantiq bor: at — nuqta, on — sirt va kun, in — ichki bo'shliq va uzun davr.
uses: There is a rise in prices.
See you at five on Monday.
We met at the station in London.
forms: depend on / rely on / believe in / apologise for / succeed in
afraid of / good at / interested in / keen on / responsible for
reason for / solution to / increase in / damage to
We need a solution to this problem.
22.tip: Aylana tasavvur qiling: in — eng katta (yil, shahar), on — o'rta (kun, ko'cha), at — eng kichik (soat, nuqta).
rules: Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida.
arrive in (shahar, mamlakat), arrive at (bino); arrive to — xato.
last, next, this, every oldidan predlog qo'yilmaydi.
discuss, marry, enter dan keyin predlog yo'q.
ex: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
Siz bilan ko'rishishni intizorlik bilan kutyapman.
He apologised for being late.
U kechikkani uchun uzr so'radi.
We arrived at the hotel on Friday.
Juma kuni mehmonxonaga yetib keldik.

23.def: Phrasal verb — fe'l + kichik so'z (up, off, on, after…) birikmasi, ko'pincha yangi ma'no beradi: give — bermoq, give up — voz kechmoq. Grammatik tomondan muhimi: to'ldiruvchi o'rtaga kira oladimi yoki yo'q.
uses: Bo'linadigan: ob'ekt ikki joyda turishi mumkin
Turn the radio off. Turn off the radio.
I can't put up with this noise.
forms: V + particle + ot  yoki  V + ot + particle
Fill in the form. Fill the form in.
I ran into an old friend.
She gets on with her boss.
23.tip: Olmosh (it, them, me) — doim «sendvich ichida»: pick it up.
rules: Olmosh zarrachadan keyin turmaydi (bo'linadigan fe'llarda).
Predlog yoki zarrachadan keyingi fe'l -ing oladi: give up smoking.
look forward to dagi to — predlog.
Rasmiy yozuvda ko'pincha bir so'zli muqobili afzal: postpone = put off.
ex: We had to put the meeting off.
Yig'ilishni kechiktirishga to'g'ri keldi.
She came up with a brilliant idea.
U ajoyib fikr o'ylab topdi.
We've run out of milk.
Sutimiz tugab qoldi.
err: I look forward to meet you.
I look forward to meeting you.

24.def: Linking words fikrlar orasidagi mantiqni ko'rsatadi: qarama-qarshilik, sabab, natija, maqsad, qo'shimcha. Muhimi — ma'nodan tashqari har birining GRAMMATIK qolipi: keyin gap keladimi, otmi yoki u yangi gap boshlaydimi.
uses: Although it was cold, we went out.
The flight was cancelled because of the fog.
It was late, so we left.
I whispered so that nobody would hear.
The hotel is cheap. Moreover, it's central.
forms: although / even though / because / since / whereas + S + V
Even though he was tired, he kept working.
despite / in spite of / because of / due to + ot / V-ing
Despite the rain, we enjoyed it.
He failed. However, he didn't give up.
so that + S + can / will / would + V1
She left early so that she could get a seat.
to / in order to / so as to + V1
He studies at night in order to save time.
signals: natija: therefore, as a result, consequently
24.tip: Avval keyin nima kelishiga qarang: to'liq gap — although; faqat ot — despite.
rules: despite of — xato: despite yoki in spite of.
despite the fact that + gap ham mumkin.
however ikki gapni vergul bilan ulay olmaydi — nuqta yoki nuqtali vergul kerak.
although va but bir gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.
ex: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
Tirbandlikka qaramay vaqtida yetib keldik.
She is shy, whereas her brother is outgoing.
U tortinchoq, akasi esa aksincha ochiq.
The shop was closed. As a result, we went home.
Do'kon yopiq edi. Natijada uyga qaytdik.
err: Despite he was tired, he worked.
Although he was tired, he worked.
Although it rained, but we went.
He was ill, however he went to work.
He was ill; however, he went to work.
